items.headline: Baleba completes first match minutes in behind-closed-doors friendly
items.summary: Carlos Baleba played his first minutes for Manchester United in a behind-closed-doors match vs Lausanne-Sport on Friday after recovering from ankle injury.

items.headline: Bruno Fernandes injury: United concerned about captain's pain during international break
items.summary: Bruno Fernandes has been playing through significant pain for weeks and missed Portugal's Nations League match, raising concerns of long-term injury.

items.headline: Dorgu suffers injury during Denmark international duty
items.summary: Patrick Dorgu withdrawn early from Denmark Nations League fixture with injury, adding to United medical concerns ahead of crucial fixture schedule.

items.headline: Manchester United target RB Leipzig's David Raum for January left-back move
items.summary: United reportedly nearing agreement with RB Leipzig captain David Raum, with release clause making January transfer likely as short-term Luke Shaw cover.
